title: Hexus Salts Lemon and Lime Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Lemon and Lime by Hexus is a zesty citrus blend that balances the sharp bite of Lemon with the smooth tang of Lime. The Lemon brings a bright, clean flavour, while the Lime adds depth and sweetness for a rounded finish. It’s a bold and refreshing option for citrus fans, delivering just the right balance of sharpness and sweetness in every puff. Formulated with nicotine salts, this e-liquid delivers fast-absorbing nicotine and a smooth yet tactile throat hit. Blended at 50VG/50PG, it’s perfect for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping in pod kits , refillable vapes , vape starter kits and low-powered devices. The Hexus Nic Salt range offers a wide choice of fruity and fizzy profiles in 10mg and 20mg strengths, crafted for consistent performance in everyday kits.
